Scholarly editions

Scholarly editions

Here you can find critical editions of two of Selma Lagerlöf's works: Gösta Berling's Saga and Invisible Links. These text are proofread against the printed edition chosen as base text. Principles for the choice of base text (as well as other overall principles) are outlined in Textkritiska riktlinjer för Selma Lagerlöf-arkivet (in Swedish). Obvious clerical- and type setting errors are corrected and some typographic modernisations have been implemented. These corrections are accounted for in "Om boken" (in the left margin, in Swedish). Bibliographic descriptions, accounts for how the texts have been established and a survey of various editions can be found in textkritisk kommentar till Gösta Berlings saga and textkritisk kommentar till Osynliga länkar (both in Swedish).

Manuskripten till Gösta Berlings saga is a survey of the manuscripts (sketches, draughts and printers copy) of Gösta Berlings's Saga, with an overall account for changes in the manuscripts. The manuscripts are also visualized in graphic form in visualisering över manuskripten till Gösta Berlings saga. Manuscripts of Invisible Links are accounted for in a table in manuskriptläget till Osynliga länkar; and there is also a survey of the publishing (in Swedish) of the various short stories in Invisible Links in översikt över publiceringen av novellerna i Osynliga länkar.

With the help of a digital collation tool various texts can be collated. Körkarlen (Thy Soul Shall bear Witness) was published in a critical book edition in 2012 (published by www.svenskavitterhetssamfundet.se) with The Selma Lagerlöf Archive as financier. A list of changes in the printers copy can be found in interna varianter i manuskriptet till Körkarlen.
